newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX'S INDOOR MATCH CREATES SOCCER HISTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX'S INDOOR MATCH CREATES SOCCER HISTORY.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam and Grasshopper Zurich entered the record books on Wednesday when their Champions' League match at Ajax's new Arena Stadium became the first major European match ever played indoors.
The retractable roof on the new multi-million dollar stadium was closed 10 minutes before the kickoff, technically enclosing the vast arena and making it an indoor venue.

But Ajax could not mark the occasion with a victory, losing the match 1-0. Their last European match in their old De Meer stadium also ended in a 1-0 defeat when they lost to Panathinaikos last season.
The first major soccer match played indoors was during the 1994 World Cup at the Detroit Silverdome when the United States drew 1-1 with Switzerland in a first round game.
